history.summary: GENERIC NAME — IDENTITY UNCERTAIN: Silchar has several Shani shrines and no documented referent for 'Shani Mandir, Silchar'. Place listings include the Tarapur Shani Mandir at E & D Colony, NH 53 (rated 4.1 on Justdial, listed hours 6 AM-9 PM); a Shani Mandir on Satsang Ashram Road, Ambicapatty (4.4, 121 reviews); and others on Jail Road, Chaengkuri Road, K V Road, near Kumbhirgram Airport (Udarbond), Lakhipur, and Sonaimukh/Cachar. This record is anchored to the Tarapur Shani Mandir as the most likely referent (named listing with address), but it may equally be another of these. Coordinates are the Silchar town coordinates as a safe approximation — NOT the exact shrine pin. No history or construction date is documented for any of them; do not invent one.

name: Shani Mandir, Silchar
town_description: Silchar is the headquarters of Cachar district in southern Assam's Barak Valley, on the banks of the Barak (Surma) River. A predominantly Bengali-speaking commercial and educational hub, it is the gateway to Manipur, Mizoram, and Tripura, served by an airport, railway station, and national highways.

travel.airport: Silchar Airport (Kumbhirgram, IXS), about 20 km away
travel.railway: Silchar Railway Station (SCL), about 2-3 km away
travel.road: Tarapur/E & D Colony, NH 53, central-eastern Silchar; reachable by auto-rickshaw

visitor_information.best_time: Saturdays are traditionally Shani's day; October to March for weather
visitor_information.opening_hours: Tarapur listing: 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily (Justdial; unverified for the other same-name shrines). No reliable Silchar-specific image was found after genuine searching; media left empty.
